subject: gk
question:
According to the Census 2011 of India, arrange the following metropolitan cities on the basis of population in ascending order?

A. Delhi

B. Mumbai

C. Kolkata
solution:
The Correct answer is __**C, A, B**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Census of 2011 **provides detailed **demographic information **about the population of India's metropolitan cities.
 
• Mumbai is the most populous metropolitan city in India as per the 2011 Census.
 
• **Delhi follows Mumbai in terms of population size.**
 
• **Kolkata is the third most populous metropolitan** city among the three mentioned.
 
• Therefore, arranging these cities in ascending order of their population results in **Kolkata, Delhi, and then Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mumbai**__

 __
 
• Mumbai, also known as Bombay, is the capital city of the Indian state of Maharashtra.
 
• It is the financial, commercial, and entertainment capital of India.
 
• Mumbai has a population of **approximately 18.4 million as per the 2011 Census**.
 
 
 
• **Delhi**__
 __
 
• Delhi, officially known as the National Capital Territory of Delhi (NCT), is India's capital city.
 
• It is the second most populous city in India with a population of around **16.3 million as per the 2011 Census.**
 
• Delhi is renowned for its rich history and cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Kolkata**__
 
 
• Kolkata, formerly known as Calcutta, is the capital of the Indian state of West Bengal.
 
• It is the principal commercial, cultural, and educational center of East India.
 
• Kolkata has a population of **approximately 14.1 million as per the 2011 Census.**
